piezas.titular: A Catalan-language train puzzle for planning shunting moves is new in the repository
piezas.entradilla: The Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository adds eight resources in the week ending 20 November: one is presented here and seven have already had their own article.
cuerpo: The resource still to be covered is “Maniobres · Cada moviment compta”, a logic game by Felip Sarroca i Gil, who is also the author of five of those that have already had an article in the paper.

recursos.captura_alt: Welcome screen of the game over a track layout with colourful numbered wagons, with a field for typing a player name.
texto: It is a railway puzzle, in Catalan, based on the Inglenook problem: the aim is to form on track A a train with the numbered wagons in a given order, moving them between several tracks with a locomotive. Wagons are dragged from a track to the locomotive and from there to another track, and each level sets a minimum number of moves; the screen counts moves and time, and offers undo, restart, a hint and a new challenge. According to its author, students can submit their result to a public leaderboard. According to the entry, it is aimed at primary, secondary, Bachillerato (the final two years of secondary school, ages 16 to 18) and adult education, and it works on planning and logic. It is played in the browser, asking only for a player name.

fuentes.titulo: Presentation in Vibe Coding Educativo (in Spanish)

piezas.comprobado: Se miró la captura (pantalla de bienvenida con campo de nombre sobre el tablero con vías, vagones y locomotora) y el texto visible de la página (nivel fácil, 40 puntos con el mínimo, contadores, botones Desfer, Reiniciar, Pista, Nou repte, pestañas Jugar, Rànquing, Sobre el joc, Com s'hi juga). WebFetch redirige a felipsarroca.github.io/jocs/Maniobres/ y solo devuelve la carga inicial (necesita JavaScript): confirma catalán, autoría y licencias. El mensaje de presentación no se pudo abrir (Telegram solo da la plantilla); se usó el de la entrada. El ránking público y los niveles salen de la ficha y del mensaje del autor, no se han visto funcionando. Autoría de Sarroca en cinco artículos previos comprobada con la lista de la entrada.
